summary: Churchill Capital Corp XII filed an 8-K reporting the consummation of its initial public offering (IPO) of 41,400,000 units at $10.00/unit, generating $414M gross proceeds, including full exercise of the underwriter's over-allotment. Each unit consists of one Class A ordinary share and one-tenth of a warrant exercisable at $11.50/share. Simultaneously, the sponsor purchased 350,000 private placement units at $10.00/unit, adding $3.5M. Net proceeds of $414M were deposited into a trust account. As a blank-check SPAC, the company now has up to two years to identify and complete a business combination; watch for target announcement and redemption risks.
